Messages.Author: Brian Tandy
Messages.Body:
If I M.D. a tapped vampire do I get it untapped? What about when the
owner gets it back--does he/she get it back tapped if I used it to bleed
or something?

Brian

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
bta...@henri.ma.utexas.edu (Brian Tandy) writes:



No Minion untapps just because he gets a new controller.
If you M.D. a tapped vamp, he stays tapped in your controlled region.
If you tap him, the owning Methuselah will get him back, tapped, when
you stop controlling him (at the start of you untap phase - before you
have the opportunity to untap him).

12.1, Phase 0 - Untap: "Any cards requiring you to take an action during
the untap phase take effect after you have untapped your cards." So
the original owner will take back the mad vampire untapped.

Not "during", but "before" as in "you control it until your next untap"

>> after all yout cards have untapped.

>12.1, Phase 0 - Untap: "Any cards requiring you to take an action during
>the untap phase take effect after you have untapped your cards." So
>the original owner will take back the mad vampire untapped.

But you only control the Malk UNTIL you next untap phase, not THROUGH your
next untap phase, so when you're untapping your controlled minions, you've
already lost control of the Malk. (and you don't untap Minions controlled
by other Methuselah's)

Which is also why you can't yield the Dementia'ed Malk (burning him if he
is contested) - because you don't control him during your untap.

You have until Midnight April 15. A moment, not a periord of time.
Read the (very clear :-) instructions supplied with 1040-A.

Example: a vampire can hunt until day.
Does he hunt until the start of day, or the end of day?

Calvin can play outside until night.
Can he stay outside until nightfall or daybreak?

You can use my lawnmower until spring. (Lawnmower Dementia :?)
Do you give it back at the start or the end of Spring?
(Most neighbors would never give it back, so this may be a bad example :-)

Till Death do us part.
Do we part at the onset of death, or once our mate is reincarnated?

You control a Malkavian until your untap phase.
Do you control it until your untap phase starts, or until it ends?

Why the confusion?

>When we (you and I) encountered this situation in a game, we decided
>it would be untapped upon return to its owner.

I have had more time to consider the logical arguments and have
changed my mind. Only a fool stubbornly clings to one side of an
argument without earnestly listening to other rational ideas :-).
